paragraphs.text: "I fight for the suns, the surface, and everything in between."
"We lost our homes and our kin. We won't let those rotters take our future as well."
"Unworthy of consecration." —Axsh, lesser cenobite
"Fall to your knees and welcome our embrace." —Qal-Sha, Priest of Norn
"The Phyrexians *are* vulnerable. Do not despair. We will prevail!" —Juryan, rebel leader
"We will mourn when there is time. For now, we survive."
"Rid them of their unfaithful organs. Bring new hearts to the unbelievers." —*Tome of Machines*, verse 1703
The squabble over succession was quickly replaced by the struggle to survive.
"The infection has spread farther than we could glimpse from the heights of Taj-Nar."
"This war is not about loxodon or leonin, Sylvok or Auriok. To defeat these rotters, we must do it together."
The need to obey was inscribed on every plate in their bodies.
A symbol of what Mirrodin once was and hope for what it will be again.
As long as one drop of the oil exists, the joyous work continues.
"May our blessings sever the tongues of the forsaken." —Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
A new bird of prey—one that hunts sentience.
The corruption stirred the heavens above, awaking a shining champion.
After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to all who survived the carnage.
"The Origin Query will wait. We must ensure we survive to return to it." —Pelyus, vedalken ordinar
Blessed by the hands of Jin-Gitaxias.
Karn's creation is now his master.
"If left in the enemy's shape too long, it might be lost to them." —Vy Covalt, Neurok agent
"The fleeting shadows of his primitive self have all but vanished." —Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur
"Your ideas will be discarded and your will repurposed."
Accurate information is a precious commodity in times of war.
"They can't even comprehend nature. How could they improve it?" —Venser
"There's no more time for secluded study. Answers are there only for those with the courage to take them."
"In its gaze I saw no mercy, no recognition that I was worthy to exist." —Kara Vrist, Neurok agent
"Phyrexians are tenacious. That's not the same thing as clever." —Tezzeret
The serum from the blinkmoths they gather greases the joints of witch engines.
A mirror to draw its eye, a rod to rouse its rage, and a sword to break its bonds.
"You are hopelessly obsolete, my brothers. Come and join the Great Work." —Rhmir, Hand of the Augur
"Let their mindless armies come and face the might of genius." —Varil, Neurok partisan
"Specimen 211 examination report. Observation: graft sublimation incomplete. Result: death. Prepare specimen 212."
"All plans begin as dreams. I intend to awaken them."
Phyrexians research with the grace of surgeons and the finesse of butchers.
"Under the suns, Mirrodin kneels and begs us for perfection." —Geth, Lord of the Vault
At first, the Mirrans aimed for its exposed gut. The survivors quickly learned to do otherwise.
Having flesh is increasingly a liability on Mirrodin.
"Ours is a glorious transmission! Behold a future where all bow to the Father of Machines." —Isila, Priest of Sheoldred
Even the dead are raw materials for the Phyrexian vision of perfection.
"The chest cavity is cleared of useless meat. I know just what to do with the space." —Gyed, Vault Priest
"Perfection is at hand. You have been freed of weakness and made *compleat*." —Sheoldred, Whispering One
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first." —Sheoldred, Whispering One
"The union of the oil and necrogen has produced many pleasing reactions." —Sheoldred, Whispering One
Life is ephemeral. Phyrexia is eternal.
Sadly, the extent of Gerkk's healing knowledge was "don't pick at it."
A productive warren requires a good deal of prodding.
Flame doesn't kneel to Phyrexia.
Shock one, awe the rest.
A golem's hands know no tenderness.
It chews open Mirrodin's husk and feeds on the outpouring of energy.
Mirran creatures that could withstand the Phyrexian oil found an abundance of crunchy snacks.
"A true warrior fights with whatever's handy." —Qerk of the Secret Warren
Its flight sets the sky itself on fire.
"They believe they're driving us back, but we're leading them to their doom." —Kethek, furnace stoker
Koth sent partisans into the Tangle to bring survivors to the safe haven of the tunnels below Kuldotha.
Being surrounded by goblins is less objectionable when they're fighting *for* you.
"All will be reforged in the fires of glory." —Urabrask the Hidden
He didn't have a word for "home," but he knew it was something to be defended.
"Drive them back! Make their underworld into their grave!" —Koth of the Hammer
"As long as we have the will to fight, we are never without weapons." —Koth of the Hammer
"I never move the same way twice. Those rotters can't grasp chaos."
"We will reveal the futility of their heresy by showing them how fragile their relics are." —Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger
"The fangren fight without comfort of any kind. We can ask no less of ourselves." —Tilien, Sylvok partisan
"So, the survivors from Oxid Ridge are on the move. Let them come and witness predation in its purest form." —Glissa
As the green sun crowned, Phyrexian prophecies glowed on the Tree of Tales.
Her warriors are the last defense against the coming storm.
"Our land will not yield to Phyrexian corruption!"
"Even a nuisance such as the pistus fly has a purpose in our new world." —Glissa
Phyrexia's spiral of consumption grows ever wider and darker.
As the Phyrexian contagion corroded Karn's body, the praetors whispered psalms to corrupt his mind.
Vorinclex removed its teeth so it wouldn't waste time chewing before moving to the next kill.
The fiercest hunters in the Tangle don't seek out the mantises. They *are* the mantises.
His crime was silence, and now he suffers it eternally.
"Domination by the strongest—that is all that matters in the Tangle now." —Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger
The Mirran partisans created hundreds of patrol sentinels to divert Phyrexian assaults from the Tangle.
"I admire it. Few pull off pluck and subservience at the same time." —Ezuri, renegade leader
"We will fight as they do: our flesh protected behind metal." —Tae Aquil, Viridian weaponsmith
"If there can be no victory, then I will fight forever." —Koth of the Hammer
Mycosynth grew unfettered beneath the black lacuna, metastasizing into a matrix of noxious energy.
"Such a creation serves no purpose other than exterminating every one of us." —Sadra Alic, Neurok strategist
Phyrexian smog clouds choked the skies, threatening creatures who couldn't comprehend the menace below.
"Use everything. Iron, rust, scrap . . . even the ground must join our cause." —Ezuri, renegade leader
"Our glorious infection has taken hold." —Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
"Anything that watches without sleep and fights without fear is a valuable ally against the Phyrexians." —Kara Vrist, Neurok agent
The faces of Geth's corpse-dredgers are disturbingly similar.
For the Phyrexians, death is not an end, nor a one-time occurrence.
Memnarch designed some myr to follow the levelers and reaffix lost parts. Mirran partisans put that instinct to good use.
"The Vanished must have sent it from beyond to aid us in this struggle." —Kessla, Sylvok shaman
"Our cause will ripen in the fertile flesh of the unworthy." —Sheoldred, Whispering One
Where nature impedes, Phyrexians overcome.
Basic senses like sight and taste are reserved for those in power.
"Pain isn't a negative stimulus. Pain is a sign of your imperfection." —Sheoldred, Whispering One
Only the goblins could make a simple machine so complex.
They watch for a new master, one more sinister than the last.
"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains." —Rhmir, Hand of the Augur
Adapted to tread on razorgrass, the rhino proved adept at treading on Phyrexians as well.
"It's a beautiful vision. Discarded debris is reborn as a singular entity." —Urabrask the Hidden
It evades Phyrexians by hiding in the spaces between seconds.
It leaps from tree to tree, revealing the enemy's positions.
Partisan spies warned that no armor would protect the body from Phyrexian infection. Neurok strategists took that as a challenge.
"It will be battle-ready before our strike at Oxid Ridge, and it will guarantee our victory." —Ketuc of the Helm
"A true Phyrexian predator. It will never know death, just as nature intended." —Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger
"Vulshok flail, Viridian shield, loxodon blade . . . Tazzir, bring the Moriok hook and assemble the rookies." —Vy Covalt, Neurok agent
"Phyrexians can't corrupt what they can't get close enough to touch."
